title: Authorized Units, Validity Periods and Unit-Use Limits for Referrals & Prior Authorizations
content:
Each Referrals & Prior Authorizations type grants a set number of units on approval, measures a unit in its own terms, and stays valid for a fixed number of calendar days.

## Units and validity by type

| Referral type | Units granted by an initial or appeal approval | One unit is one | Validity (calendar days) | Weekly unit cap | Completed telehealth visit uses a unit | Restore window (calendar days) | Coverage re-verified when last verification older than (days) | Progress note to payer every (units) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | 6 | visit | 180 | 0 (none) | Yes | 30 | 90 | 0 (none) |
| HMO Specialist Referral | 3 | visit | 90 | 0 (none) | Yes | 30 | 30 | 0 (none) |
| Standing Specialist Referral | 12 | visit | 365 | 0 (none) | Yes | 30 | 30 | 0 (none) |
| Out-of-Network Referral | 3 | visit | 90 | 0 (none) | No | 30 | 30 | 0 (none) |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | 12 | visit | 60 | 3 | No | 14 | 30 | 6 |
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization | 1 | study | 30 | 0 (none) | No | 30 | 30 | 0 (none) |
| Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization | 1 | procedure | 60 | 0 (none) | No | 30 | 30 | 0 (none) |

## Meaning of each column

- **Validity** is counted in calendar days from the first date of validity: the last date of validity (the valid-through date) is the first date of validity plus the validity days, less one day.
- **Weekly unit cap** is the most units usable in one calendar week, Monday to Sunday; 0 means there is no weekly cap.
- **Telehealth** states whether a completed telehealth visit with the rendering provider uses a unit.
- **Restore window** is the number of calendar days after a unit is used within which a unit counted in error may be restored.
- **Coverage re-verification** is the age, in calendar days, beyond which coverage is re-verified before the next unit is used.
- **Progress note** is the number of units after which a progress note goes to the payer to keep the authorization current; 0 means none.

## Worked validity dates (hypothetical first dates of validity)

| Type (validity days) | First date of validity | Valid-through date |
|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization (30) | 2026-03-02 | 2026-03-31 |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (60) | 2026-03-02 | 2026-04-30 |

In each row the first date of validity counts as day 1, so 30 days starting 2 March end on 31 March, and 60 days starting 2 March end on 30 April.
